response.summary: 1 accepted. In the 8.2 handoff loop, only the first transfer in a response now counts. Any later transfer in the same response gets an error result ("Rejected: one handoff per turn"), so no acknowledgement names an agent that never runs. The prose now states the rule, and a dated note for the fourth review records the old behaviour. CHANGELOG line added. 25 tests pass. Worth checking first: the 'first wins' rule. The other option was rejecting the whole batch.

responses.reason: The finding is correct. In the old loop, weeks/week-08-multi-agent-systems.md:242-249 overwrote st.active and st.payload on every transfer_to_ block, and each one got a 'Handed to …' result, so only the last recipient ran. Now a `moved` flag lets the first transfer through. Later transfers get tool_result(..., is_error=True) and change no state, so every successful acknowledgement names the agent that actually runs next. Non-transfer calls run as before.
responses.changes: weeks/week-08-multi-agent-systems.md (sketch, prose after it, dated note); CHANGELOG.md
